subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
We count to design a counter with counting 
sequence  0 – 1 – 2 – 3 – 0, using 
 
Circuit-A → Asynchronous counter 
 
Circuit-B → Synchronous counter 
 
FFs used in circuit-A and circuit-B are of same 
logic family and logic gates used has 0 delay while 
FFs have delay of 25 nsec. Then which of the 
following is true? 
 
(a) Maximum clock frequency is same in both the 
circuits. 
 
(b) Maximum clock frequency is double in circuit-
B compare to circuits-A. 
 
(c) Maximum clock frequency is half in circuit-B 
compare to circuit-A 
 
(d) None of these 
[NAT]

options.text: Maximum clock frequency is same in both the
Maximum clock frequency is double in circuit-
Maximum clock frequency is half in circuit-B

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-12 (Sequential Circuits (Part-5)).
